acf.speaker_position: Platform Engineering & IT Operating Models Consultant

blocks.html: Krzysztof is a Software Engineer & Management Consultant, specializing in Platform Engineering & IT Operating Models. Team Topologies Advocate, Platform Engineering Ambassador, PJATK academic lecturer & military history enthusiast, who treats IT as one of his greatest hobbies. Commercially in IT since 2013 in various roles (developer, analyst, manager - now consultant), professionally associated with Exerizon as Principal Platforms Architect. "Platform Engineering for Managers" course author, blogger (khalasa.com) & junior YouTuber (@khalasa-com).
